programme.desc: A gunman (George Mathews), intent on murdering his girlfriend, purchases an alibi.

programme.title: You Got to Have Luck
programme.desc: An escaped convict (John Cassavetes) takes refuge in a farmhouse occupied by a young housewife (Marisa Pavan).

programme.title: The Older Sister
programme.desc: A year after the murders, a newspaper reporter (Joan Lorring) attempts to interview Lizzie Borden (Carmen Mathews) and her sister about the killings.

programme.title: The Derelicts
programme.desc: A bum (Robert Newton) witnesses a murder and decide to take advantage of the situation. With Philip Reed.

programme.title: And So Died Riabouchinska
programme.desc: A police detective (Charles Bronson) investigating a murder focuses on a strange ventriloquist (Claude Rains).

programme.title: Safe Conduct
programme.desc: A female reporter (Claire Trevor) encounters problem trying to leave Eastern Europe after meeting a soccer star.

programme.title: Place of Shadows
programme.desc: A man (Mark Damon) arrives at a monastery bent on revenge and is convinced by a kind priest (Everett Sloane) to mend his heart.

programme.title: Back for Christmas
programme.desc: An English man (John Williams) murders his wife and moves to California, thinking he has committed the perfect crime.

programme.title: The Perfect Murder
programme.desc: Two greedy brothers plan to murder their elderly aunt (Mildred Natwick) in an attempt to inherit her money.

programme.title: There Was an Old Woman
programme.desc: A desperate couple (Charles Bronson, Norma Crane) plans to rob an eccentric old woman (Estelle Winwood).

programme.title: Whodunit
programme.desc: An angel (Alan Napier) allows a murdered mystery writer (John Williams) to return to Earth to uncover his killer.

programme.title: Help Wanted
programme.desc: An unemployed man (John Qualen) needing money is hired by an unknown employer (Lorne Greene) to commit murder.

programme.title: Portrait of Jocelyn
programme.desc: A man (Philip Abbott) is startled to see a portrait of his first wife four years after she disappeared.

programme.title: Orderly World of Mr. Appleby
programme.desc: An antiques dealer (Robert H. Harris) decides his art objects are too beautiful to sell. With Louise Larabee.

programme.title: Never Again
programme.desc: An insecure woman (Phyllis Thaxter) who can't control her drinking loses control at a cocktail party.

programme.title: The Photographer & the Undertaker
programme.desc: Professional killers (Jack Cassidy, Harry Townes) with the same employer find that each has the other as his next target.

programme.title: Thou Still Unravished Bride
programme.desc: Only hours before his wedding, a London detective discovers that his American fiancée has disappeared.

programme.title: Completely Foolproof
programme.desc: A wealthy land developer is shocked to discover that his wife is seeking to divorce him.

programme.title: Power of Attorney
programme.desc: A dishonest lawyer takes over a rich widow's holdings but underestimates her companion's (Geraldine Fitzgerald) wrath.

programme.title: The World's Oldest Motive
programme.desc: A philandering husband arranges his wife's murder, then has a sudden change of heart and frantically tries to prevent it.

programme.title: The Monkey's Paw: A Retelling
programme.desc: A gruesome surprise awaits a desperate man who thinks that a monkey's paw will bring him financial luck.

programme.title: The Second Wife
programme.desc: A mail-order bride (June Lockhart) has ultimately tragic suspicions about the strange death of her husband's first wife.

programme.title: Gentleman From America
programme.desc: Using a haunted house in their ploy, two men (Ralph Clanton, John Irving) scheme to con a wealthy American (Biff McGuire) out of his money.

programme.title: The Baby Sitter
programme.desc: A garrulous babysitter (Thelma Ritter) enjoys being the center of attention after her employer is murdered.

programme.title: The Belfry
programme.desc: A murderer (Jack Mullaney) hides from a posse after killing a school teacher's (Pat Hitchcock) fiancé.

programme.title: The Hidden Thing
programme.desc: A man (Biff McGuire) struggles to remember the license plate number of the vehicle that killed his fiancée (Judith Ames).

programme.title: The Legacy
programme.desc: While vacationing in Palm Beach, a reserved heiress (Leora Dana) becomes the romantic focus of a prince (Jacques Bergerac).

programme.title: Mink
programme.desc: A woman (Ruth Hussey) is stunned to learn that a mink coat she bought had been stolen from a previous owner.

programme.title: Decoy
programme.desc: A young pianist (Robert Horton) is framed, by the woman (Cara Williams) he loves, for a murder he did not commit.

programme.title: The Creeper
programme.desc: A New York City woman (Constance Ford) is convinced she will be the next victim of a serial killer. With Steve Brodie.

programme.title: Momentum
programme.desc: Murder results when a wife (Joanne Woodward) nags her husband (Skip Homeier) to stand up for himself.

programme.title: Wet Saturday
programme.desc: After his daughter commits murder, a man (Sir Cedric Hardwicke) finds a way to protect his family's reputation.

programme.title: Fog Closing In
programme.desc: An escaped mental patient (George Grizzard) encounters a woman (Phyllis Thaxter) who's afraid to be alone in her house.

programme.title: De Mortuis
programme.desc: Two friends unknowingly tell a middle-aged professor (Robert Emhardt) about his wife's (Cara Williams) reputation.

programme.title: Kill With Kindness
programme.desc: A brother and sister (Hume Cronyn, Carmen Mathews) scheme to defraud an insurance company. With James Gleason.

programme.title: None Are So Blind
programme.desc: A man (Hurd Hatfield) assumes another identity to kill his aunt (Mildred Dunnock) but forgets one important detail.

programme.title: Toby
programme.desc: A man (Robert H. Harris) is overjoyed to learn that his long-forsaken love (Jessica Tandy) has searched him out to marry him.

programme.title: Alibi Me
programme.desc: A murderer (Lee Philips) searches for an alibi after he kills a rival gangster (Chick Chandler) in a fit of rage.

programme.title: Conversation Over a Corpse
programme.desc: Two sisters (Dorothy Stickney, Carmen Mathews) resort to desperate measures to keep their house.

programme.title: Crack of Doom
programme.desc: A man (Robert Horton) stakes his job, home and life savings on the turn of a card. With Robert Middleton.

programme.title: Jonathan
programme.desc: A young man is overcome with grief when he learns of his father's demise and accuses his new mother of the crime.

programme.title: Better Bargain
programme.desc: An underworld kingpin (Robert Middleton) learns that his wife (Kathleen Hughes) has been unfaithful to him. With Henry Silva.

programme.title: Rose Garden
programme.desc: A publisher (John Williams), intrigued by an unpublished murder mystery, visits the author (Patricia Collinge).

programme.title: Mr. Blanchard's Secret
programme.desc: A mystery writer with an overactive imagination conjures up murderous thoughts about her new neighbors.

programme.title: John Brown's Body
programme.desc: A wife (Leora Dana) regrets having her sane husband (Russell Collins) committed to a mental institution.

programme.title: Crackpot
programme.desc: Newlyweds (Biff McGuire, Mary Scott) meet a volatile stranger (Robert Emhardt) while on their honeymoon.

programme.title: Nightmare in 4-D
programme.desc: A gorgeous actress (Barbara Baxley) asks a neighbor (Henry Jones) to help her hide the body of a murder victim.

programme.title: My Brother Richard
programme.desc: A man (Harry Townes) kills a gubernatorial candidate to ensure his brother's (Royal Dano) election. With Inger Stevens.

programme.title: Manacled
programme.desc: A prisoner tries to convince a police sergeant to allow him to escape while they are on their way to San Quentin.

programme.title: A Bottle of Wine
programme.desc: A man tries one last desperate attempt to win back the woman he loves by inviting her new lover for a drink.

programme.title: Malice Domestic
programme.desc: A woman (Phyllis Thaxter) is suspected of trying to poison her husband (Ralph Meeker).

programme.title: Number Twenty-Two
programme.desc: A man (Rip Torn) becomes intrigued with police routine when he is picked up for robbing a candy store.

programme.title: End of Indian Summer
programme.desc: An insurance investigator (Steve Forrest) goes undercover to check out a widow (Gladys Cooper) suspected of murdering two husbands.

programme.title: One for the Road
programme.desc: A wife (Louise Platt) suspects her husband (John Baragrey) of cheating on her and decides to do something about it. With Georgann Johnson.

programme.title: Cream of the Jest
programme.desc: An alcoholic actor (Claude Rains) blackmails a producer (James Gregory) to get a part in a play. With Paul Picerni.

programme.title: I Killed the Count
programme.desc: An inspector (John Williams) is confused when two men (Alan Napier, Charles Cooper) confess to the murder of a count.

programme.title: I Killed the Count
programme.desc: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Williams) finds he has three murderers who admit to killing the same man (Anthony Dawson).

programme.title: I Killed the Count
programme.desc: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Williams) finds he has three murderers who admit to killing the same man.

programme.title: One More Mile to Go
programme.desc: A man (David Wayne) trying to dispose of his murdered wife's body is stopped by a motorcycle cop (Steve Brodie).

programme.title: Night Fever
programme.desc: A wounded man (Tom Simcox) who shot a police officer seeks a nurse's (Colleen Dewhurst) aid to escape from his prison bed.

programme.title: Off Season
programme.desc: Fired, a trigger-happy police officer (John Gavin) takes a job guarding summer homes. Directed by William Friedkin.

programme.title: Episode 221
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Episode 224
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Episode 225
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his wordeven the Air Forceand soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Episode 227
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But waitdid he even want to?

programme.title: Episode 228
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Episode 229
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hootervilleand she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Episode 230
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Episode 301
programme.desc: It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

programme.title: Episode 302
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Episode 304
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Episode 305
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Episode 306
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Episode 307
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Episode 308
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Episode 309
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Episode 310
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Episode 312
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Episode 313
programme.desc: Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

programme.title: Episode 314
programme.desc: Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

programme.title: Episode 315
programme.desc: Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

programme.title: Episode 316
programme.desc: After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc stood him up at the alter on their big day.

programme.title: Episode 317
programme.desc: Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

programme.title: Episode 319
programme.desc: Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

programme.title: Episode 320
programme.desc: Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

programme.title: Flight To Nowhere
programme.desc: The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

programme.title: Episode 322
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Episode 323
programme.desc: Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

programme.title: Episode 324
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Episode 325
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Episode 326
programme.desc: It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

programme.title: Episode 327
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.title: Episode 329
programme.desc: Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

programme.title: Episode 330
programme.desc: It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

programme.title: Episode 401
programme.desc: Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

programme.title: Episode 402
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.title: Episode 403
programme.desc: Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

programme.title: Episode 404
programme.desc: When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

programme.title: Episode 405
programme.desc: The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

programme.title: Episode 406
programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.title: Episode 407
programme.desc: Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

programme.title: Episode 408
programme.desc: The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

programme.title: Episode 409
programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.title: Episode 410
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: The Blue Feather
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Episode 414
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programme.title: Episode 416
programme.desc: All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

programme.title: Episode 417
programme.desc: Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

programme.title: Episode 418
programme.desc: After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

programme.title: Episode 419
programme.desc: When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

programme.title: Episode 420
programme.desc: While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

programme.title: Episode 421
programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.title: Episode 423
programme.desc: Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

programme.title: Episode 424
programme.desc: Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

programme.title: Episode 425
programme.desc: Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

programme.title: Episode 501
programme.desc: Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

programme.title: Episode 503
programme.desc: Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

programme.title: Episode 504
programme.desc: Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

programme.title: Episode 505
programme.desc: When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

programme.title: Episode 506
programme.desc: Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

programme.title: Episode 507
programme.desc: Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

programme.title: Episode 508
programme.desc: Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

programme.title: Episode 510
programme.desc: Oliver is asked to speak at the local high school about his illustrious law career and makes quite an impression on student Kathy Baxter. Oliver must contend with Kathy's fawning as well as her jealous boyfriend is not very happy with Oliver.

programme.title: Episode 511
programme.desc: Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

programme.title: Episode 512
programme.desc: Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

programme.title: Episode 513
programme.desc: Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a "small" display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

programme.title: Episode 514
programme.desc: Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

programme.title: Episode 516
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

programme.title: Episode 517
programme.desc: Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

programme.title: Episode 518
programme.desc: Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

programme.title: Episode 519
programme.desc: Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

programme.title: Episode 520
programme.desc: Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

programme.title: Episode 521
programme.desc: After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

programme.title: Episode 522
programme.desc: Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

programme.title: Episode 523
programme.desc: Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

programme.title: Episode 524
programme.desc: When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

programme.title: Episode 525
programme.desc: When Eb places an ad in a magazine claiming to be a wealthy landowner, it catches the eye of a young socialite. When the young woman makes an unexpected visit to Hooterville, Eb is forced to keep up his ruse.

programme.title: Happy Birthday
programme.desc: Oliver is upset when he finds out Arnold the pig and he share the same birthday. Jealous that Arnold is getting more attention than he is, Oliver becomes convinced that Lisa is throwing him a surprise party and drives all over town in search for it.

programme.title: Episode 601
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa play host to four children from the city, who find themselves in Hooterville as part of a rural exposure program. The kids learn how to milk the cow, pick vegetables, plant seeds, and share sleeping quarters with four-legged friends.

programme.title: The Coming Out Party
programme.desc: Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

programme.title: Episode 605
programme.desc: Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

programme.title: Episode 606
programme.desc: The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

programme.title: Episode 607
programme.desc: There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

programme.title: Episode 608
programme.desc: Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

programme.title: Episode 609
programme.desc: Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

programme.title: Episode 610
programme.desc: Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

programme.title: Episode 611
programme.desc: Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

programme.title: Episode 612
programme.desc: After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

programme.title: Episode 613
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

programme.title: Episode 614
programme.desc: Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

programme.title: Episode 615
programme.desc: The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

programme.title: Episode 616
programme.desc: Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

programme.title: Episode 617
programme.desc: Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

programme.title: Episode 618
programme.desc: While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

programme.title: A Girl For Drobny
programme.desc: Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

programme.title: Episode 622
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

programme.title: Episode 624
programme.desc: When Oliver decides to attend night school and enrolls in a farming class, Lisa does the same, taking psychology. Before long, many of the residents of Hooterville are lining up for appointments with the eminent Dr. Lisa.

programme.title: Episode 625
programme.desc: Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Michael Keaton (5/14/92)
programme.desc: Jokes are the theme on this show, with Martin Short, Terri Garr and Michael Keaton. Lotsa fun!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Adrienne Barbeau (12/20/73)
programme.desc: Actress Adrienne Barbeau worked as a secretary before landing on Broadway in "Grease" and then getting cast in TV hit "Maude."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Christopher Reeve (7/26/79)
programme.desc: Superman himself Christopher Reeve describes taking acting classes with Robin Williams. Meanwhile, Diahann Carroll reflects on her lowcut dress and dressing to please men.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Emmanuel Lewis (5/5/83)
programme.desc: TV actor Emmanuel Lewis admits he watches The Tonight Show "only once in a blue moon." Comedian David Steinberg claims that nudity can be really boring.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - John Ritter (3/2/84)
programme.desc: Comic actor John Ritter whines about doing commercials, being student body president at Hollywood High, and getting his star on The Walk-of-Fame.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Olivia Newton-John (11/12/76)
programme.desc: Grammy magnet Olivia Newton-John sings 2 of her numerous chart-topping tunes and fills in Johnny on growing up down under in Australia.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Patrick Duffy (2/12/80)
programme.desc: Dallas heartthrob Patrick Duffy says he always dreamed of becoming a TV star but now he wants to change his nice guy image. Also reveals his love for off-road racing.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Ricky Schroder (11/19/80)
programme.desc: 10-year-old TV star Ricky Schroder (Silver Spoons) chats about his Mexico vacation, spending his earnings and his 2 girlfriends! Also tells Johnny the questions he does not like to be asked.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Ricky Schroder (11/9/82)
programme.desc: 12-year-old TV star Ricky Schroder (Silver Spoons) shows off his skill juggling plastic eggs. Then Johnny gives it a try, unaware that Ricky swapped the plastic ones for real eggs. What a mess!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Ricky Schroder (2/6/85)
programme.desc: 15-year-old TV star Ricky Schroder tells Johnny that when he gets his license, he wants to buy a Corvette. Also chats about dating, getting good grades in school and learning to sing.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Tim Reid (6/19/85)
programme.desc: The genius behind WKRP's Venus Flytrap, actor Tim Reid describes his experience auditioning for The Tonight Show. Also details his dream about his dear grandma.

programme.title: The Haunting Of Whaley House
programme.desc: When a tour guide breaks into America's Most Haunted House, a bit of amateur ghost hunting with friends turns into more horror than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Ape vs. Mecha Ape
programme.desc: Recognizing the power of its captive giant Ape, the military makes its own battle-ready, Mecha Ape. But its first practical test goes horribly wrong, leaving the military no choice but to release the giant Ape to stop the robot.

programme.title: Corporate Retreat
programme.desc: Our Heroes find themselves with a group of white-collar survivors and someone tries to kill Murphy. Suddenly faced with a possible killer in their midst, our Heroes play a dangerous game of "Clue"-with zombies!

programme.title: Alien Origin
programme.desc: Recently discovered footage from a lost military expedition exposes the horrifying truth about the genesis of life on earth.

programme.title: Frenemies
programme.desc: Doc and Our Heroes are reunited with Sketchy and Skeezy when they take refuge in a working Barber Shop full of mysterious, and murderous, characters

programme.title: The Anacondas
programme.desc: Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.

programme.title: Evil Nanny
programme.desc: A couple hires a live-in nanny, who soon starts showing her neglectfulness. However, the nanny established legal residency in the home, embarking the couple on a legal battle to reclaim their home.

programme.title: Exorcism The Possession Of Gail Bowers
programme.desc: Based on one of the true incidents that inspired THE EXORCIST, a psychiatrist suggests that the parents perform an actual Catholic exorcism on their daughter, who actually believes she is possessed.

programme.title: Alien Siege
programme.desc: After an alien space craft appears above Washington, D.C., a disparate band of residents in a small Connecticut town must fight off a unit of alien soldiers on the hunt for the President of the United States after his escape chopper crash lands nearby.

programme.title: 5-Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: A beautiful island's aquatic life faces a new terror: the 5-Headed Shark, a demented starfish-shaped monster threatening Puerto Rico's beaches

programme.title: Dracula: The Original Living Vampire
programme.desc: Det. Amelia Van Helsing hunts a killer of young women. All evidence leads to the untouchable Count Dracula.

programme.title: AE Apocalypse Earth
programme.desc: A group of refugees from Earth land on an exotic planet, where they must fight ruthless aliens to survive.

programme.title: King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table
programme.desc: In this modern retelling of the classic tale, facing certain defeat, Merlin banishes the evil enchantress Morgana and her son Mordred to the ends of universe. Vowing revenge, Morgana and her son return to Earth, hell-bent on destroying every last descendant of King Arthur and his Knights.

programme.title: Battle For Pandora
programme.desc: After a help signal from a research vessel makes it back to Earth, the Space Force sends a rescue ship to Pandora. They discover Pandora is already inhabited by a highly evolved species that won't give up their Earthling prisoners without a fight.

programme.title: Duel
programme.desc: Enders, Zombies, Wild Beasts, and whatever twisted horrors The Man can dish out, none of it stops Addy in her pursuit of Lucy. Meanwhile, Lucy makes The Man's life a living hell, summoning all manner of Zombie obstacles.

programme.title: All Good Things Must Come to an End
programme.desc: Our Heroes drive through Los Angeles on their way to the mobile CDC lab. They discover the CDC lab isn't just a lab...it's a submarine! Dr. Merch welcomes our Heroes aboard and not a moment too soon as the Zeros show up hot on their heels.

programme.title: Ape X Mecha Ape: New World Order
programme.desc: After an attempt on Abraham the giant ape's life, a journalist uncovers a global plot to awaken an ancient creature. Humanity's last hope is an uneasy alliance between Abraham and Mecha Ape MkII to stop the threat and save the Earth.

programme.title: Crisis of Faith
programme.desc: Warren's inability to stop the mayhem causes a crisis of faith in the whole group. Surrounded by Zombies in an abandoned church, their faith is restored after encountering a mysterious stranger who turns out to be something much more.

programme.title: Zunami
programme.desc: When the last surviving cosmonaut crashes to earth, Citizen Z gets a real live buddy, but it quickly becomes clear that his new friend has a secret agenda. Meanwhile, a massive zombie herd forces the team to take refuge in a morgue.

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: Domestic terrorists skyjack the world's largest passenger plane on its maiden voyage. When the President is notified that her brother is on board, she must choose between family and the safety of the people in the cities below.

programme.title: Mt. Weather
programme.desc: Warren and Our Heroes must stop Zona from launching operation "Black Rainbow" which will release a flesh eating bacteria to "cleanse" the landscape of zombies -- and humans -- so Zona can repopulate the mainland with their offspring.
Jack and Melissa are frightened by their son's bizarre and violent behavior; they soon learn that he is the gateway to the Apocalypse, and it will happen on his birthday, 11-11-11.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: Civilization is laid to ruin when a super-race of aliens invade Earth. Massive walkers cover the planet annihilating all in their path as cities crumble.

programme.title: Ape vs. Mecha Ape
programme.desc: Recognizing the power of its captive giant Ape, the military makes its own battle-ready, Mecha Ape. But its first practical test goes horribly wrong, leaving the military no choice but to release the giant Ape to stop the robot.

programme.title: Down the Mississippi
programme.desc: Our Heroes try to cross the Mississippi but are involved in a boating accident. 10K is rescued by Sketchy and Skeezy and they offer to take him in if he'll help them out with their latest scam.

programme.title: 2010 Moby Dick
programme.desc: A modern adaptation of the classic novel of the captain of a high tech submarine and his obsessive quest to destroy the enormous prehistoric whale that maimed him.

programme.title: Doc Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
programme.desc: Doc finds himself taken captive by a psychotic nurse and her surviving mental patients in an homage to "One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest" but with Zombies. Doc discovers that 10K is also being held prisoner by the lunatics.

programme.title: Welcome to the Newpocalypse
programme.desc: Warren recovers from the drone crash with handsome, mysterious Cooper; Doc and the others finally arrive in Newmerica, where they meet George, who is helping form the new country.

programme.title: 100 Million BC
programme.desc: During the 1940s, government scientist Dr. Frank Reno (Michael Gross) lost a platoon of American soldiers in a botched time-travel experiment. When a rescue team transports the survivors -- including Reno's brother, Erik (Christopher Atkins) -- from prehistoric times to 2008, they unwittingly allow an uninvited guest to follow them. Now, a desperate group of modern Navy SEALs and their World War II-era counterparts must stop a vicious Tyrannosaurus rex from ravaging the streets of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Alien Convergence
programme.desc: When flying reptilian creatures wreak havoc all over the world, the survivors' only hope of stopping them is a new, state-of-the-art fighter jet piloted by the only team that knows how to use the technology.

programme.title: Zoombies 2
programme.desc: A game ranger arrests poachers, only to save them when zombie animals attack. Trapped in the zoo, the ranger and poachers must form an uneasy alliance to stop the beasts from spreading a super-zombie virus to the world.

programme.title: No Mercy: Part 2
programme.desc: In this "FLASHBACK MOVIE," the old crew meet a feral kid who leads them to Mercy Laboratories, a mysterious compound of survivors awaiting the return of "The Man," a villain of the Apocalypse who carries around a list of soon-to-disappear people.

programme.title: Independents' Day
programme.desc: After aliens invade earth and destroy all our nuclear arsenal, they give us a choice: either emigrate to a new, better planet or be killed. While most earthlings resign themselves to leaving, the president of the United States turns to a rogue militia to fight back and expose the truth before the human race is obliterated.

programme.title: Monster Island
programme.desc: As the world tries to stop a giant Kaiju bent on destruction more and more monsters appear - each one more terrible than the last - leaving mankind defenseless until our heroes reach out to a specialist versed in monster lore.

programme.title: Billy The Kid
programme.desc: When Jack's former mentor is shot, the investigation leads Jack to a disturbing discovery involving the world of illicit drug labs.

programme.title: Skin Deep
programme.desc: Sue and the team get word about an upcoming act of Eco-terrorism. When Myles discovers his cholesterol is too high, he's not the only one who suffers.

programme.title: The Holocaust Survivor
programme.desc: Sue and Jack investigate the claim of a deaf Holocaust survivor who insists she's recently seen a wanted Nazi war criminal. Myles and Bobby square off against office manager Randy.

programme.title: Pilot Pt 2
programme.desc: Sue finds some on the team are not as welcoming to a deaf woman, her unique lipreading ability and her hearing dog Levi as Agent Jack Hudson.

programme.title: The Fugitive
programme.desc: The team goes into high gear when a fugitive escapes from a prison. Sue has misgivings when invited to attend a wedding where she'll come face to face with people from high school.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: Sue tries to honor a request a killer be brought to justice. Bobby, Jack, and Myles have a competition over who can draw the highest bids as the dream dates for charity.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 1
programme.desc: The lone wolf received an assassination request to avenge a clan on the brink of being abolished. The plot thickens as they got caught in a scheme full of betrayals and deceit while being pursued relentlessly by the Yagyu clan.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Hjerson (Dubbed) S1 E4: Episode 4
programme.desc: While heading for a peaceful swim, Hjerson finds himself in terrible danger. As the search for the beach suspect intensifies, the case also becomes increasingly personal for Hjerson.

programme.title: Pure
programme.desc: While Holly buries herself in an investigation, Duncan faces problems at home.

programme.title: Loose Ends
programme.desc: Haunted by Phil's death, Macy digs deeper into the streets, questioning informants and tracking leads as she searches for a connection between Pete and the killing.

programme.title: Day Ones
programme.desc: Tensions rise as Go-Go, one of Macy's closest allies, confronts a longtime enemy while Macy continues her relentless pursuit of those responsible for Phil's murder.

programme.title: Revenge
programme.desc: Simon Cross pulls out all the stops in an attempt to take Smith into Flatland and force Armageddon. Amy wills her way into Flatland, and discovers the horrible secret behind her relationship with Noel Jagger.

programme.title: To Be a Somebody (Part Three)
programme.desc: DCI Charlie Wise takes over the investigation. As the police close in on him, Albie reveals a few explosive tricks to carry out his revenge for Hillsborough.

programme.title: Memories of me and him
programme.desc: Soshun Kouchiyama, a tea master at Edo Castle, secretly fights injustice by beating up powerful oppressors, with the help of his friends.

programme.title: Origins II
programme.desc: After learning the truth as to where the Olivine compound was hidden, Cameron chooses to escape into exile, that is until a confrontation with General Nexxus forces Cameron to realize his true importance to the future of Humanity.

programme.title: Genesis Part II
programme.desc: After the break-in, Cameron decides that he has had enough, fortuitously leading him to discover a secret in his father's office. With a little ingenuity, Cameron and Boris begin to piece together clues to a mystery Mr. Turner left behind.

programme.title: Red Sonja
programme.desc: Red Sonja and Conan team to save a kidnapped wizard, who has the secret of youth.

programme.title: Season 1, Conan The Adventurer 120: Antidote
programme.desc: While Conan celebrates in a tavern, an unseen assassin shoots the Cimmerian with a poisoned arrow. A medicine man examines the wound and says Conan will die if someone doesnt get the antidote, which must be taken through a wall of Hissah Zul warriors.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Mathias is forced to return to the front line following an arson attack on a farmhouse which put a mother and child in danger.

programme.title: Denver McKee
programme.desc: While celebrating the return of his daughter Connie from a fancy school, former lawman U.S. Deputy Marshall Denver McKee is asked to assist in the capture of an outlaw gang.

programme.title: The Texan: S1 E20 - The Man Behind The Star
programme.desc: Longley's old friend, pretty ranch owner Martha Driscoll, negotiates a highly successful sale at the end of a cattle drive. Although her friends urge her to put her money in the bank until she's ready to board a train home, Martha refuses and ends up being robbed and murdered - but not before naming her killer - Clint Gleason, one of her trailhands.

programme.title: Next Stop the Grannies
programme.desc: The Wonderland audition for a big US TV show when some super-fans turn up and start competing with each other. Meanwhile Nate drops a bombshell which could destroy everything

programme.title: The Gunfighters
programme.desc: Tate takes on a train car full of fast guns when a simmering rancher vs. homesteader dispute escalates.

programme.title: The Beast Within
programme.desc: Malone goes after a healer that's been filled with the spirit of a demon in exchange for safe release from the village. The girls must set their differences aside and learn to trust each other.

programme.title: Show-Time
programme.desc: Star coiffeur Oliver Nienaber is in panic, as well. Anticipating that he could be the next victim, he asks Robin Van Rees, Head of Rinkhals Security, for protection. Again, we don't know yet how Nienaber is linked to the other Mauser victims and what makes him think he might be the next one.

programme.title: Riptide: S1 E10 - Long Distance Daddy
programme.desc: Two Cambodian orphans stow away on a jet to visit their American sponsor, Nick, only to be marked for death after witnessing a murder.

programme.title: Riptide: S1 E12 - Raiders Of The Lost Sub
programme.desc: Well educated, but just as goofy, Murray's sister shows up unexpectedly, and persuades the boys to look for a sunken WW2 German submarine.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Beowulf gets to work rebuilding the town's defenses--a need that becomes even greater when iron miner Greff is attacked by one of the most dangerous Mudborn creatures known to humans--a Troll.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: With Slean and his uncle Abrecan failing to warn Herot about the Wulfing Raider attack, the marauders arrive at the peripheries of an unsuspecting Herot and release their Barghest wolves to terrorize the town.

programme.title: The Heart of Lord Trash
programme.desc: Returning to London Robert's group is waylaid by Fedora and her thugs, who steal the incubus, but they are rescued by Garson. Tenebrae launches an attack on Bulstrode's headquarters, stealing the all-important Calyx, before arriving at Robert's house for a final, deadly showdown.

programme.title: The Mentor
programme.desc: Sue meets Jack and Bobby's FBI Mentor when he brings the team in on a case to sting a North Korean terror group. Lucy reconnects with her old high school love.

programme.title: Bat Masterson Leaves the West
programme.desc: After leaving Dodge City, Bat Masterson takes a job as manager of Denver's Palace Theatre. There he falls in love with Emma Walter, a jugging virtuoso known as the Queen of Clubs, and begins to question his life as a gunslinger.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove: Part II - On The Trail
programme.desc: McCrae and Wood's cattle drive faces deadly situations. Sheriff July Johnson heads to Texas, and former prostitute Lorena is abandoned by Jake and kidnapped by the psychotic Blue Duck.

programme.title: Our Friend, Chaos
programme.desc: An explosion rips through the downstairs of Beth-H, changing lives there forever.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Hjerson (Dubbed) S1 E5: Episode 5
programme.desc: An unpublished novel inspires a copycat murder at a restaurant. Only five people, including the author, have read the work- so it must be an inside job. Or is it? The author contacts Hjerson and Klara to crack the case.

programme.title: Don't Take My Heart, Don't Break My Heart
programme.desc: When The Herald uncovers a sex scandal, Holly makes a powerful enemy.

programme.title: The Founders
programme.desc: As the streets become a battlefield, Macy faces impossible split-second choices that could mean life or death for herself and her allies.

programme.title: You Have to Remember
programme.desc: Unexpected alliances form while old loyalties collapse. As friends become enemies, Macy struggles to know whom she can trust amid mounting casualties.

programme.title: We Gone See
programme.desc: Caught in the crossfire of a gang war reaching its peak, Macy fights to protect her loved ones while confronting the devastating consequences of her choices.

programme.title: Aurora
programme.desc: Mitchell narrowly escapes death at the hands of a pair of vengeful archangels, one of whom he may have loved in the past, while Khan and Smith maneuver their pawns into place, in anticipation of a final showdown.

programme.title: The Juror #6 Job
programme.desc: When Parker attends jury duty in order to keep up the legitimacy of one of her aliases, she notices some strange things at the trial. It seems someone is trying to buy a favorable verdict... but not if the Leverage team can steal it first!

programme.title: Wife love, mother love, a hint of wind
programme.desc: Soshun Kouchiyama, a tea master at Edo Castle, secretly fights injustice by beating up powerful oppressors, with the help of his friends.

programme.title: Beware of Falling Rocks
programme.desc: Cameron and Boris begin to question Lucy's mysterious past. Their suspicion grows when they learn Lucy must attend an exclusive meeting at Condon Aerospace, so the two decide to sneak into the event to investigate matters further.

programme.title: Tunnels
programme.desc: Cameron wants to enter a skateboarding competition at Crater skate park but soon finds out that he is grounded and must clean his father's studio. Upon doing so, Cameron discovers a way to sneak out to the skate park after all.

programme.title: The Secret Society
programme.desc: Concerned about Cameron's behavior, the school sends him to a psychologist. When Boris visits the psychologist in Cameron's place, he reveals a little too much information, and they soon realize that this is no ordinary psychologist.

programme.title: The Cavern
programme.desc: A violent storm traps Conan in a cave with Hissah Zul's hit man.

programme.title: Season 1, Conan The Adventurer 121: Lethal Wizards
programme.desc: Three wizards, Penor, Gero and Norbu, decide to join the Cimmerian so they can be Conans advisors when he becomes the new ruler. Their plan is to worm their way into Conans confidence, then destroy him and take over as rulers.

programme.title: Redbad - The Legend Part 3
programme.desc: During a time of epic battles and bloodshed, the legend of pagan warrior king Redbad is born, but so is a new weapon against his people: Christianity.

programme.title: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: Matsou and his wife Hatoya nurse Ben back to health after he gets injured in a fight. However, a bigoted farmer takes action when Ben gives them a piece of land as a thank you.

programme.title: Press Conference
programme.desc: GHF and The Wonderland's joint press conference for their tour doesn't go to plan once AJ gets involved but Nate is distracted by his relationship-status with Chloe.

programme.title: Quiet After The Storm
programme.desc: A girl is shot by her jealous boyfriend and a lynch mob is after him.

programme.title: Cracks
programme.desc: A judge dies, Leon arrives, and the class-action case goes to trial.

programme.title: The Long Road To Nowhere
programme.desc: After a novelist is killed by an unknown entity, Mike Hammer agrees to investigate the murder. However, plot twists lead to more questions, and Hammer learns there's more to the story.

programme.title: Disaster Strike Force: Quake
programme.desc: The team responds to the threat of a potentially devastating earthquake in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Disaster Strike Force: Mega Quake
programme.desc: The entire California coastline is threatened as a 20.0 earthquake looms.

programme.title: Big Mama
programme.desc: As the group struggles with the disappearance of one of its own, they accept sanctuary in a town run by its Sheriff and his troops. Meanwhile, Dmitri inches closer to achieving his darkest goal.

programme.title: The Final Act (Part 1)
programme.desc: Helen Mirren stars as DS Jane Tennison, a seasoned detective plunged into the alien world of teen girls after a 14-year-old goes missing.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Grizzly Rampage
programme.desc: A rogue bear turns a camping trip deadly, forcing five friends to flee through the forest with a ranger.

programme.desc: The warden of an African prison is holding Fujiko captive. Lupin and his gang infiltrate the prison and attempt to break Fujiko out, but they become the target of the Iron Lizards.
